subject: MAP update: Axon Health timeline reset & milestone reprioritization
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@axonhealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@axonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft + proposed milestones (target close 2027-07-15)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Per our discussion I attached the first draft of a mutual action plan (Axon-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx). Below is a short recap and the milestones I captured. Please confirm or flag anything I got wrong.

Top-level: target close 2027-07-15 (contract signed + pilot kickoff). If the procurement calendar changes, we can rebaseline — we just wanted a concrete checkpoint for planning.

Proposed milestones / owners / dependencies:
- Milestone 1: Security kickoff & evidence exchange (Target: 2027-05-28) — Owner: Elena (Axon) / Marissa (Redwood) — Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence export, IP/data residency checklist.
- Milestone 2: Proof-of-concept performance tests (Target: 2027-06-15) — Owner: Tom (Axon) / Sergio (Redwood) — Dependencies: sample dataset access, modest traffic window.
- Milestone 3: Commercial terms finalized / SOW approval (Target: 2027-06-30) — Owner: Tom (Axon) / Ben (Redwood) — Dependencies: procurement PO window, finance review.
- Milestone 4: Contract signature & pilot kickoff (Target: 2027-07-15) — Owner: Tom (Axon) / Ben (Redwood).

Open asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the procurement calendar and whether a July signature is realistic?
2) Please share a single point of contact for security evidence (if not Elena).
3) Any constraints on hosting/region/data residency we should note?

Next steps I propose: 1) you review the attached MAP and mark edits, 2) we reconvene for a 30-minute call week of May 24 to finalize milestones, and 3) Redwood will provide a one-page pilot SOW template for procurement (attached).

Attachments: Axon-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-template.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@axonhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Beckett <t.beckett@axonhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T18:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + proposed milestones (target close 2027-07-15)

Ben —

Thanks for the clean recap and the draft MAP. Quick update: procurement just shifted our internal timeline — the earliest they can sign is now end of Q3. Can we rebaseline the MAP to a 2027-09-30 target close? The drive here is a calendar shift on our finance side (budget approvals moved to the September board).

Given that, we'd like to reprioritize the milestones: security/compliance gating first (we need to finish the SOC 2 evidence review and a short data residency confirmation before any perf POC). We still want the POC, but want it to happen after security is cleared in August.

Updated asks from Axon:
- Security point of contact: Elena (me) for now — I will bring in our InfoSec lead (Avery Patel) after our work week next Tue (May 25).
- Procurement lead: Tom (copied) will own.
- Budget close: expect to confirm by 2027-09-10, signature target 2027-09-30.

I attached our internal procurement milestone calendar (sent as a separate doc). We will also need a short note on Redwood's data retention policy and whether you support a regional (us-east) only deployment for the pilot.

If you can update the MAP ordering and push the close to 2027-09-30, we can review and then schedule a follow-up for the week of May 31.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of IT Operations, Axon Health
elena.ruiz@axonhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@axonhealth.com>, Tom Beckett <t.beckett@axonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP draft + proposed milestones (target close 2027-07-15)

Elena / Tom —

Appreciate the heads up and the procurement calendar. Understandable — we can absolutely rebaseline. I updated the MAP into v2 (Axon-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx) and reordered milestones per your request: security gating first, then POC, then commercial. New target close: 2027-09-30.

High-level changes (see attached v2):
- New Milestone A: Security evidence exchange & InfoSec review (Target: 2027-06-10 -> updated to 2027-06-25 to align with your InfoSec availability) — Redwood owner: Marissa Cole — Deliverables: SOC 2 artifact export, data residency questionnaire.
- New Milestone B: Legal & procurement prep (Target: 2027-07-15) — Redwood owner: Ben Carter / Dylan Brooks (pricing/flex) — Deliverables: one-page SOW, commercial term sheet.
- New Milestone C: POC performance window (Target: 2027-08-15 to 2027-09-01) — Redwood owner: Sergio Alvarez — Dependencies: signed data access agreement, one-week traffic window.
- New Milestone D: Final sign & pilot kickoff (Target: 2027-09-30) — Redwood owner: Ben Carter.

Notes / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm Avery Patel as InfoSec contact once available?
2) Confirm whether a us-east-only pilot is required (this will affect hosting config and a small delta in cost).
3) Tom, can you confirm procurement's preferred contract cadence (PO vs. direct e-sign)?

Marissa / Sergio / Dylan — can you each reply with a one-paragraph estimate of per-milestone effort (hours / calendar lead) so I can bake into the MAP? If possible by EOD Monday so we can share the v2 with Axon ahead of the May 31 touch.

Attachments: Axon-MAP-draft-v2.xlsx, SOW-template.pdf

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Axon MAP rebaseline — quick estimates needed

Team —

Axon pushed the close to 2027-09-30 and wants security gating first. I updated the MAP (v2) and asked for owner-level estimates. Please reply inline with a short estimate for your milestones:
- Marissa: security evidence exchange & InfoSec review — estimate hours + any blocking items.
- Sergio: POC performance window — estimate duration + required infra support.
- Dylan: procurement/legal lead — estimate time to produce SOW + any discounts/finance gating to be aware of.

Marissa: will you take point on hosting/data residency Qs?

Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — I can lead security. I expect 12-18 hours of readiness work (artifact collection + answers). Blocking: need Axon to confirm exact SOC 2 scope and provide sample dataset access by 6/20.

Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — For POC perf, plan for 2 weeks of testing with a 3-person support window (SE + infra + engineer). Setup ~8-10 hours. We'll need data access and a test token.

Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — SOW and terms: 8-12 hours to produce draft + 1 sync with finance. If they request a committed discount we should surface that to RevOps; likely needs a manager approval.

I'll collate these into the MAP v2 and send to Axon after we get Avery's InfoSec availability.

Thanks —
Ben
